# @three-ws/intel

> Token sentiment + market intelligence in one import. Sentiment pulse, aixbt narrative intel, momentum-ranked project scans, and live Solana token snapshots — the three.ws intelligence SDK.

@three-ws/intel is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/intel`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-intel/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-intel/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-intel/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-intel/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
